text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — I pushed a new Grafana dashboard with a per-route quantile heatmap + MIG-hotspot mapping to help connect tail token latency to specific MIG slices and kernel choices. Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd1234/route-quantiles PTAL

Ryan Patel: Nice, opening it now. Quick glance: /generate has a persistent p99 bump around 18:20 UTC and slice 3 shows sustained ~78% SM occupancy during the burst.

Priya Singh: Could be KV cache fragmentation forcing extra lookups into slower slices. I noticed increased KV read amplification in that window.

Luca Marino: Can we add a kernel_selector dimension to the heatmap so we can disambiguate when flash-attn vs fused kernels are used by route?

Maya Chen: Done — added kernel_selector and model_version panels, plus per-route p50/p95/p99 lines. Also overlaid recent deploys as annotations.

perf-bot: Profiling run #412 completed: kernel-switch count increased by 23% on route /generate after yesterday's batching heuristic tweak.

Ryan Patel: That's probably the regression. Was the batching heuristic change the one that increased max-batch-wait to 12ms? @Priya any KV eviction correlation?

Priya Singh: Yes — KV_evictions jumped ~2.1x in the same window. Attaching a short trace snippet from the profiler:

```
# trace excerpt
kv_lookup count=1234 slice=3 model=redwood-v2 seq_len=512
kernel_selected=flash_attn_v2
kernel_switch_reason=seq_len_bucket_mismatch
latency_ms=15.6
kv_evicted=true
```

Luca Marino: That kernel_switch_reason tag is gold. If the runtime keeps switching kernels mid-batch it increases kernel launch overhead and can push hot work to a single MIG slice.

Maya Chen: Plan: rollback the batching tweak on canary and run an A/B with kernel_selector pinned to the previous selector. Scheduling rollback in 10m.

deploy-bot: Rollback canary started for pool-inference-canary at 1958643410 — will post end-of-run metrics.

Ryan Patel: If the rollback reduces p99 and SM occupancy on slice 3, we should block-promote a fix to the batching policy and add an alert rule.

Luca Marino: Suggest alert: kernel_switch_rate > 20% AND kv_eviction_rate > 1.5x for any route for >5m. Also add an estimated VRAM fragmentation panel per MIG (use free_block_count heuristic).

Maya Chen: Agreed — adding both alert and VRAM fragmentation panel. Thanks for the quick feedback. I'll post the canary results in this thread. :white_check_mark:
